metadata.title: get_id
metadata.description: HTTP-triggered Logic App building block that finds Microsoft Sentinel incidents matching caller-supplied criteria (title prefix/suffix or exact title, incident status, created-time window) and answers synchronously with each match's ARM id, GUID and attached Sentinel entities, plus a count. It also WRITES: with activate_incident set to true, every match that is neither already Active nor Closed is moved to Active through the azuresentinel managed connector; closed incidents are refused per incident and never reopened. Answers 200 on success including zero matches, 400 on request validation, 409 when a matched incident was refused because it is closed, 500 on an internal failure, 502 on an upstream read or incomplete result, and 504 when an activation outcome is unknown. The Logic App's system-assigned managed identity requires Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the workspace.
prerequisites: Microsoft Sentinel Responder on the Log Analytics workspace named by LogAnalyticsResourceID, granted to this Logic App's system-assigned managed identity. Microsoft Sentinel Reader is NOT sufficient: the entities call is a POST under /incidents and the activation is a write, both of which need the Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents/* action set.
AzureSentinel API connection (this template creates it if absent); it authenticates with the Logic App's managed identity, so no interactive consent is needed.
The workspace must answer on the pinned api-versions (IncidentApiVersion for the incidents list, IncidentEntitiesApiVersion for incidents/{id}/entities).
metadata.author: get_id

metadata.description: Name of the Consumption Logic App. Pass it explicitly on deploy so redeploys update this instance.
Azure region of the playbook and its AzureSentinel API connection.
Full ARM resource id of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace. Leading slash, no trailing slash: the management URI is built by concatenating https://management.azure.com with this value.
api-version for the Sentinel incidents list call. Pinned to the version proven in production by the TI-handler playbook.
api-version for POST {incidentArmId}/entities. Separate from IncidentApiVersion because the list call stays on the proven preview version while the entities operation is taken from a GA version.
Incidents requested per page ($top). IncidentPageSize x MaxIncidentPages must not exceed the documented 1,000-incident list ceiling.
Maximum pages the listing loop reads. Reaching it answers 502 IncidentListTruncated; nothing is returned or activated.
Sentinel's documented maximum number of incidents returned to a list request. Accumulating this many rows is treated as truncation even when the service returned no nextLink.

Maximum and default max_results for a read-only call. Sized so the synchronous answer fits the 120-second inbound request limit: 2 list pages at ListRequestTimeout plus 16 entity calls at IncidentRequestTimeout.
Maximum and default max_results when activate_incident is true. Sized for two upstream calls per incident (entities plus activation) inside the same 120-second limit.
Incident status names the trigger accepts (matched case-insensitively, sent to Sentinel in this casing inside the server-side $filter).
Per-call timeout for one incidents list page.
Per-call timeout for one entities read and one activation write.
Overall timeout for the pagination loop. Keep it at or above MaxIncidentPages x ListRequestTimeout and far below the 120-second inbound limit, so the page-cap branch stays reachable.

title_prefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix the incident title must start with. Combined with title_suffix as an AND pair. At least one of title_prefix, title_suffix or title_exact is required.

title_suffix.description: Case-insensitive suffix the incident title must end with. Combined with title_prefix as an AND pair.

title_exact.description: Case-insensitive full title. OR-ed with the title_prefix/title_suffix pair, so one call can match a templated title family and a fixed title at once.

incident_status.description: Sentinel incident statuses to match: New, Active, Closed (case-insensitive). A bare string is accepted and treated as a one-element array. Omitted means every status except Closed. Cannot contain Closed when activate_incident is true.

created_after.description: Only incidents created at or after this instant. ISO-8601 UTC of the exact form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Applied server-side.

created_before.description: Only incidents created strictly before this instant. Same format as created_after. Applied server-side.

activate_incident.description: When true, every matched incident that is neither already Active nor Closed is moved to status Active. Closed incidents are refused per incident and never reopened. Anything other than boolean true or the string 'true' is read as false.

max_results.description: Maximum matched incidents to return and, when activating, to write. 1..16 for a read-only call, 1..8 when activate_incident is true. Defaults to that ceiling. total_matched and limited reveal how many matches were dropped.

Compose_Validation_Errors.inputs: @union(if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['has_title_criteria'], json('[]'), array('at least one of title_prefix, title_suffix or title_exact is required.')), if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['created_after_valid'], json('[]'), array('created_after must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.')), if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['created_before_valid'], json('[]'), array('created_before must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.')), if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['window_order_valid'], json('[]'), array('created_after must be earlier than created_before.')), if(greater(length(body('Filter_Unknown_Statuses')), 0), array(concat('incident_status must contain only: ', join(parameters('AllowedIncidentStatuses'), ', '), ' (got: ', join(body('Filter_Unknown_Statuses'), ', '), ').')), json('[]')), if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['activate_closed_conflict'], array('activate_incident cannot be combined with incident_status Closed. This block does not reopen closed incidents.'), json('[]')), if(outputs('Compose_Request_Flags')?['max_results_valid'], json('[]'), array(concat('max_results must be an integer between 1 and ', string(outputs('Compose_Effective_Ceiling')), '.'))))

Compose_Incident_Filter.inputs: @join(union(if(empty(body('Select_Status_Terms')), array('(properties/status ne ''Closed'')'), array(concat('(', join(body('Select_Status_Terms'), ' or '), ')'))), if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['created_after']), json('[]'), array(concat('(properties/createdTimeUtc ge ', outputs('Compose_Request')?['created_after'], ')'))), if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['created_before']), json('[]'), array(concat('(properties/createdTimeUtc lt ', outputs('Compose_Request')?['created_before'], ')')))), ' and ')

Compose_list_handler_error.inputs: @{if(equals(variables('Last_Page_Status_Code'), 0), concat('Incident listing did not complete: the listing loop stopped after ', string(variables('Pages_Read')), ' page(s) without an upstream answer.'), concat('Unable to list Sentinel incidents (HTTP ', string(variables('Last_Page_Status_Code')), '): ', variables('Last_Page_Error')))}

Compose_list_failure_error.inputs: @{if(equals(variables('Last_Page_Status_Code'), 0), concat('Incident listing did not complete: the listing loop stopped after ', string(variables('Pages_Read')), ' page(s) without an upstream answer.'), concat('Unable to list Sentinel incidents (HTTP ', string(variables('Last_Page_Status_Code')), '): ', variables('Last_Page_Error')))}

body.error: @{concat('Incident listing stopped after ', string(variables('Pages_Read')), ' page(s) and ', string(length(variables('Raw_Incidents'))), ' incident(s) with more results pending. No incidents were returned or activated. Narrow the request with created_after or incident_status.')}

runError.message: @{concat('Incident listing stopped after ', string(variables('Pages_Read')), ' page(s) and ', string(length(variables('Raw_Incidents'))), ' incident(s) with more results pending. No incidents were returned or activated. Narrow the request with created_after or incident_status.')}

body.error: The playbook failed while filtering the incidents it had already listed. No incident was activated.

runError.message: The playbook failed while filtering the incidents it had already listed. No incident was activated.

inputs.title: @items('Foreach_Matched_Incident')?['title']
inputs.entities_error: @if(not(equals(string(coalesce(outputs('Compose_Entities_Ok'), 'unavailable')), 'unavailable')), null, concat('Unable to read incident entities (HTTP ', string(coalesce(outputs('Get_Incident_Entities')?['statusCode'], 502)), '): ', substring(string(coalesce(body('Get_Incident_Entities'), '')), 0, min(length(string(coalesce(body('Get_Incident_Entities'), ''))), 1000))))

runError.message: Entity retrieval failed before the matched incidents could be assembled. No incident was activated.

@if(equals(toLower(string(coalesce(outputs('Compose_Activation_Body'), ''))), 'active'), null, concat('Sentinel did not report status Active after the update (HTTP ', string(coalesce(outputs('Update_Incident_Active')?['statusCode'], 502)), '): ', substring(string(coalesce(body('Update_Incident_Active'), '')), 0, min(length(string(coalesce(body('Update_Incident_Active'), ''))), 1000))))

Compose_Result_Errors.inputs: @union(if(greater(length(body('Filter_Entity_Failures')), 0), array(concat('entity retrieval failed for ', string(length(body('Filter_Entity_Failures'))), ' of ', string(length(outputs('Compose_Result_Summary')?['incidents'])), ' matched incident(s).')), json('[]')), if(greater(length(body('Filter_Activation_Failures')), 0), array(concat('activation failed for ', string(length(body('Filter_Activation_Failures'))), ' incident(s).')), json('[]')), if(greater(length(body('Filter_Activation_Refused')), 0), array(concat('activation refused for ', string(length(body('Filter_Activation_Refused'))), ' closed incident(s).')), json('[]')), if(greater(outputs('Compose_Result_Summary')?['activation_unknown_count'], 0), array(concat('activation outcome unknown for ', string(outputs('Compose_Result_Summary')?['activation_unknown_count']), ' incident(s).')), json('[]')), if(outputs('Compose_Result_Summary')?['matched_incomplete'], array(concat('entity assembly did not complete for ', string(sub(length(outputs('Compose_Limited_Incidents')), length(variables('Matched_Incidents')))), ' matched incident(s).')), json('[]')))
